verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt (HTTP 200 at docs.fireflies.ai/llms.txt) that indexes the docs as .md pages. Fireflies also documents a Documentation MCP Server that lets AI tools search and retrieve its docs, plus an LLM-development page with a downloadable file meant for AI coding tools. missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), no independent user reports of agents consuming these docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The Fireflies Documentation MCP Server enables AI tools to search and retrieve information directly from the Fireflies documentation.
Upload the downloaded file to your AI coding tool.
